description: Source code for the OpenClawChatComposer SwiftUI view component, implementing a chat input interface with toolbar, attachments, and text input, supporting different platforms (macOS and others).

classes.name: ChatComposerTextView
classes.description: NSViewRepresentable wrapper around a custom NSTextView for macOS, handling text input, sending, and image paste handling.

classes.name: ChatComposerNSTextView
classes.description: Custom NSTextView subclass implementing specialized paste and key handling for message input.

methods.name: pickFilesMac
methods.description: Opens an NSOpenPanel for selecting image files on macOS.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles file URL drops onto the view for macOS, adding dropped files as attachments.

methods.name: loadPhotosPickerItems
methods.description: Loads selected photos from PhotosPicker on iOS, adding them as attachments.
